## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2e3dbd35edfa7815b2c59aa98e94b0b8f5a78dbb`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/release-aftercare.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/true-green.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/execute.mjs, scripts/pm/rerun-failed.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, .github/workflows/pr-automation.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/lint.yml

Inputs read: card #30111 (body, three comments), PR #30155 (body, file list, net diff of head against `origin/main` at `471add32` — the merge-base is `6d1dc7f8`, the merge commit of PR #30135, and `main` has not moved any of the three files since), the check-runs on the head, and the cited files at `origin/main`. No build, test or gate was run; the record template was printed with `record-recognisers.mjs --template`.

### ① Derived judgments

**Item 1 — a report that is not a finding.** Present, in `lanes/security.md` 接收与台账 (lines 16–18, 20). It says what the card says: a doorbell-less `triage` advisory (outside report or relay live test) is read through `advisory_read`, claimed as a `received` row on the seat post, judged; a finding goes to `draft` through `advisory_state` and the fix path, a non-finding goes to `closed` with the row marked non-finding and no detail. Checked against the relay: `ADVISORY_TRANSITIONS` on `main` (`ops.mjs` line 1023) allows `draft` from `triage` and `closed` from `triage`, so both moves are real relay moves. Line 20 widens the id-source list to "维护者、门铃或中继实测", which is the card's third source. No restatement of a rule another file holds.

**Item 2 — ledger states.** The vocabulary line (23) is unchanged from what PR #30135 left: `received → fixing → merged → closed;挑中发布再 awaiting publish → published`. The only residue is line 38, which now assigns the two publish states to their actors: the maintainer's approval of the list is `awaiting publish`; the seat's relay publish is `published`, "照第 3 节". Checked against the three orders:
- close once the fix merges: line 43 (收口: "修复合入即经中继 `advisory_state` 置 `closed`") plus `merged → closed` in the vocabulary — covered;
- the maintainer approves the publish list: line 35 (the pre-release list) plus line 38 (`awaiting publish` is the approval) — covered, and consistent with `security-findings.md` §3 line 24 ("只发维护者为该版批准的清单:经中继先定版本再发布") and §9 line 63 ("发布清单归维护者");
- the seat's relay publish: line 38 (`published`) — covered, consistent with §3 line 24 and with the relay's `ADVISORY_TRANSITIONS` (`published` from `draft` through the versions fence). No contradiction found; the old "the seat stops at awaiting publish" wording is gone (removed by #30135) and nothing restates it.

**Item 3 — a release's contents by ancestry.** Present, in `lanes/security.md` 呈维护者 (lines 36–37), beside the publish-list line. Placement is right: `release-aftercare.md` holds production roll-out duties and has no publish list (grep for 公告/清单/祖先 returns nothing). The text is the card's rule: ancestor of the tagged commit via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`; merge time earlier than tag time is not proof.

**Item 4 — work moved after the response.** Present, in `review-checklist.md` 测试与门禁证据 (lines 49–50). Placement is right: `true-green.md` is the per-repository index of how to run checks ("各仓真绿跑法索引"), not a review step. The claim holds against `ci.yml` on `main`: `dogfood`, `dogfood-verify` and the temporal job carry `if: … github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'` (lines 2077, 2395, 2618). This PR's own head shows the trap: `Dogfood Regression Gate` reads `success` on the head while its three shards are `skipped`. `packages/qa/dogfood/test` exists.

**Item 5 — CI recoveries the relay leaves.** Present, in `platform-readings.md` directly under the `rerun-failed.mjs` rule (lines 289–291), plus the merge-group fold into line 76. Placement is right: `rest-channel.md` holds the per-operation channel table and the three non-migratable items; it holds no rerun or re-queue rule. Each claim is checked under ④ below.

**Lines removed to pay for headroom** — each deleted line read, and where its rule now lives:

`lanes/security.md`
- "修复 = 本席向 `os-dev` 下无卡派发令,`xhigh`;机制只进派发令与公告,⛔ 不进 PR 与评论" → `security-findings.md` §3 line 28 (verbatim) and §2 line 14; the new line 27 points at §3. Kept.
- "L/XL、build 重、长跑或浏览器验证的派修走 `mode:cloud`,余 `mode:subagent`(`../execution-duties.md`)" → merged into line 27 with the same criteria; only the `execution-duties.md` pointer is dropped (the rule itself still lives there, three `mode:cloud` lines). Kept.
- "修复 PR 的契约复核归本席:记录停在规则层,机制只在本席本地的 `security-note.md`(第 6 节)" → §6 line 45 (verbatim); line 28 keeps "归本席,照第 6 节". Kept.
- "要定契约的修复交维护者(呈前照下节)" → §6 line 46 and the tail of new line 28. Kept.
- "维护者批准清单后,本席经中继发布,照 `../security-findings.md` 第 3 节;⛔ 不发清单外的" → rewritten as line 38 with the state owners added; "⛔ 不发清单外的" and the §3 pointer survive. Kept.
- "卡:`Fixes #N` 合入即关,本席补落地记录并摘 `pm:*`;`Part of #N` 卡末段落地时本席自关" → `landing-operations.md` lines 63–64 (MERGED closes `Fixes` cards with labels stripped, closes out `Part of` cards, and adds the delivered/remaining comment); line 42 still points there. Kept.
- "本席接管:挂 `security` 标签,⛔ 不追加细节;是否移入公告并关卡交维护者定,⛔ 不代关" → §7 lines 50–51 (verbatim); new line 48 points at §7. Kept.
- the two 分诊 lines → merged into line 49 with all three facts (push to the maintainer and hand over per `triage.md`, the doorbell is only for speed, the vacant-seat case goes to §7); `lanes/triage.md` line 20 carries the triage half. Kept.

`review-checklist.md`
- "两个 job 的 `conclusion` 都须为 `success`,门禁族跑在其内;⛔ 不因报告写了本地绿跳过" → "皆 `success`" folded into line 42; "the gate families run inside" is AGENTS.md line 508 (`Lint & Repo Gates` (all `check:*` gates)); "do not skip on a reported local green" is line 47 ("本地并集只证本地子集,⛔ 不替缺席者"), equivalent force. Kept.
- the two head-pin lines → one line 45 that carries both halves (run `head_sha` and the dev's copied short sha, mismatch or missing ⇒ not booked either way). Kept.
- "席位核对门禁证据 = 钉 head 的 check-runs" → line 47 minus "钉 head", which line 45 now states for every reading. Kept.

`platform-readings.md`
- line 143 "报文里的 user ID 只是报文…" → a second copy of line 96 ("⛔ 不据限流报文里的 user ID 推池子跨席共用"); the surviving line is the stronger one. Kept.
- the GraphQL-pool pair → one line 132 that still names the three non-migratable items in `rest-channel.md` 〈不可迁移〉 (lines 66–70 there) and that draft flips and auto-merge arming go through relay ops. Kept.
- "`rerun_failed_jobs` 复用原 run 的提交与合并 ref,不拿新 main 重算。⇒ …只能 `git merge origin/main` 推提交;判别看修复合并时间" → line 287 keeps the reuse fact and the remedy; the `git merge origin/main` recipe is `landing-operations.md` line 29. **The one loss is "判别看修复合并时间"** — the stated method for deciding whether the run's base lacks the merged fix. See should-fix 1.

No deleted line loses a rule outright; one loses a judgment aid.

**Ceilings and widths.** `CEILINGS` on `main` (`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`): `lanes/security.md` 53, `review-checklist.md` 76, `platform-readings.md` 458; the head's files count 53 / 76 / 458. `MAX_LINE_BYTES` is 120; the longest added line is 120 bytes. No added line carries an issue number or a date.

**Charter header.** `lanes/security.md` line 5 says the file carries no finding, id, path, object name or mechanism. The new text names relay op names (`advisory_read`, `advisory_state`), advisory states (`triage`, `draft`, `closed`), the pre-existing `GHSA-ID` placeholder and a `git merge-base` command. None is a finding, an advisory id, a path, an object name or a mechanism. Holds.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right. The file list is three prose files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`; nothing in any released package's `files[]` moves. The PR body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, both true for a diff that publishes nothing. Check Changeset is `skipped` on the head by that label, as `pr-automation.yml` line 308 intends.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's out-of-scope note is a real disagreement, not a wording difference. `SKILL.md` line 94 (全体座位的不变量): "内容写只走 REST 代理,⛔ 无 MCP 写,唯一例外 `rerun_failed_jobs`(限 CI 红单次重跑,先核 head)" — a standing MCP write exception. Against it: `platform-readings.md` line 288 routes the one re-run through `rerun-failed.mjs`; that tool's header (`scripts/pm/rerun-failed.mjs` lines 48–52) is RELAY-ONLY ("⛔ there is no direct path"), the relay's `actions: write` is minted for that stroke alone; and AGENTS.md line 413 ("Every GitHub write leaves through `scripts/pm/`, as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`") outranks the skill. So the SKILL.md exception is stale text that still reads as permission. It is outside this card's file surface, `SKILL.md` is at headroom 0, and it is a Tier S edit of its own — a follow-up card is the right disposition, not a change to this PR. The card should also name `platform-readings.md` line 287, which still spells the MCP tool name `rerun_failed_jobs` for the merge-ref reuse fact (a platform reading, true of the relay's POST too, but the name invites the same misreading).

### ④ Design judgment

Item 5, against the real relay and workflows on `main`:
- **`run_rerun_failed` re-runs `ci.yml` only.** True. `RERUN_FAILED_WORKFLOWS = ['.github/workflows/ci.yml']` (`ops.mjs` line 734), matched whole by the `workflow` fence of `RERUN_FAILED_FENCES`; the `event` fence further limits it to `pull_request` runs, and `once` to `run_attempt 1`. `validate.mjs` refuses any request-time key that would widen it. A `lint.yml` or `pr-automation.yml` run cannot pass the fence.
- **An `edited` event re-runs Check Changeset.** True. `pr-automation.yml` line 43: `types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled, edited]`; the `changeset-check` job's `if` (lines 308–311) filters only on the `skip-changeset` label and the Version Packages branch, never on `github.event.action`. A body edit is a `pull_request.edited` event; its run lands in the `meta` concurrency group (line 52), so it neither cancels nor is cancelled by the `code` group's run, and the new `Check Changeset` check-run on the same head supersedes the cancelled one by name.
- **`pr_update_branch` on a head level with `main` is a no-op.** True, and measured rather than spelled: `execute.mjs` `confirmUpdateBranch` treats the platform's 422 as a no-op landing only when the compare reads `behind_by 0` (battery at lines 1579/1816: "a 422 is a no-op only when the compare measures the head not behind its base"); a head still behind, or a stale `expected_head_sha`, is a FAILED action. Once `main` has moved, the 202 path authors a real merge commit as the App, and `lint.yml` runs on `pull_request` (line 23) with no type filter, so `synchronize` brings a full run.
- The merge-group fold on line 76 names `Checkout repository` as the known-flaky example; that is the step's name in `ci.yml` (five occurrences). The next-but-four line ("同一 PR 第二次被踢 ⇒ 停止重投") already limits it to once, as the PR body says.

Item 1 against the relay: both `advisory_state` moves the new line asks for exist in `ADVISORY_TRANSITIONS` on `main`. Item 4 against `ci.yml`: holds (above). Item 3: a git fact, correctly stated. The charter header holds (①).

**Check-runs on the head at review time:** every concluded run is `success` or `skipped` (Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Test Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate aggregates, Type Check · workspace / debt ledger, the three scoped Lint jobs). `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` — the two required contexts the review checklist pins — were still `queued`/`in_progress`, with no red beneath them. Per Prime Directive 14 the landing waits for every check green; the owning seat re-reads them at enqueue. Nothing in this record stands in for that reading.

**Findings**

- Should-fix 1 (`platform-readings.md` line 287): restore a judgment method for "基上缺已合修复". The deleted "判别看修复合并时间" was the only stated way to decide it, and the PR body's reason for dropping it (addition 3 rules out time-for-ancestry) conflates two questions: addition 3 is about a tag's commit versus merge times, while a PR run's merge ref is computed from `main` when the run is created, so "the fix merged after this run was created" is the right test for the rerun case. A spelling that fits the width: "⇒ 基上缺已合修复(修复合入晚于该 run 建立)时重跑无效,改 merge main", or the equivalent in the landing-operations line it points to. Not a FAIL: the rule (re-run is useless, merge `main`) survives in two places; only the deciding method is gone.
- Should-fix 2 (follow-up card, not this PR): the `SKILL.md` line 94 MCP exception versus the relay-only re-run (③). File it with the dedupe words the dev listed, plus `platform-readings.md` line 287.
- Note (no action): line 27 drops the `../execution-duties.md` pointer for the `mode:cloud` criteria; the rule still lives there and is restated in full on line 27, as it was before this PR.

No must-fix.

Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cc4efc5aa055176b5453e1f591f9750a9803a81d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs

Delta review on the prior PASS record for head `2e3dbd35ed` (comment 6637469885): only the diff between that head and this one is judged; the earlier findings stand where this diff does not touch them. The delta is one commit touching one file, `platform-readings.md` (+3 −3 against the old head). The PR's net diff against its merge-base `6d1dc7f8` is still the same three files (+23 −23), and GitHub's file list agrees.

### ① Derived judgments

**Should-fix 1 of the prior record — restored.** The rerun pair now reads (lines 286–287):
- "`rerun_failed_jobs` 复用原 run 的提交与合并 ref,不拿新 main 重算。"
- "⇒ 基上缺已合修复(修复合入晚于该 run 建立)时重跑无效,改 merge main。"
The merge-time judgment is back, in the spelling the prior record asked for, and it states the right test for the rerun case (the run's merge ref is computed from `main` when the run is created). The "不拿新 main 重算" clause from the original line is also back. Closed.

**The line it was paid for by — the `minimal_output` fold (lines 146, old 148–149).** Deleted:
- "⛔ `minimal_output: true` 不裁 `list_issues` 的 `body`,⛔ 永不当省额度手段写进任何 skill。"
- "没有参数能关掉 `body`:要么整表 107 点,要么换窄接口(点数未测)。"
Replaced by one line: "`minimal_output` 不裁 `list_issues` 的 `body`,也无参数关得掉;⛔ 永不当省额度手段写进 skill。"

Rule by rule:
- `minimal_output` does not trim `body` — kept.
- no parameter turns `body` off — kept ("也无参数关得掉").
- never write it into a skill as a quota-saving means — kept, with the ⛔.
- the 107-point cost of a full `list_issues` — verified still stated in the quota section of the same file, line 98: "一次 `list_issues`(34 张卡、perPage=100)= 107 点", unchanged on `main` and at this head. The old line 149 was a restatement of it.
- the narrow-interface alternative "(点数未测)" — verified never measured: the only place it appeared in `.claude/` on `main` was that line itself (git grep for 窄接口 and 107 点 across `.claude/` returns lines 98 and 149 of this file and nothing else), and it carried its own "未测". An unmeasured alternative is not a reading and not a rule; dropping it loses nothing a seat could act on.
No live rule is lost by the fold.

**Ceiling and widths.** `CEILINGS` on `main` holds `platform-readings.md` at 458; the file at this head counts 458 lines. The two added lines measure 94 and 116 bytes against `MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120. No added line carries an issue number or a date.

**Note (no action required on the diff):** the PR body's "deleted (said elsewhere)" table was not extended with the `minimal_output` fold; the body grep for `minimal_output`, `107` and the restored line returns nothing. The accounting in this record covers it; the dev may add the row for the audit trail.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: one prose file under `.claude/**`, nothing published; `skip-changeset` remains right.

### ③ Boundary flags

Nothing new in this delta. The `SKILL.md` line 94 follow-up from the prior record is unchanged and still owed as its own card; line 286 still spells the MCP tool name `rerun_failed_jobs` for the merge-ref reuse fact, which that card should also name.

### ④ Design judgment

The restored judgment holds against the relay: `run_rerun_failed` re-runs a run's failed jobs on the run's own merge ref (`RERUN_FAILED_FENCES` pin the run, attempt 1, and the pull's current head; nothing recomputes the base), so a fix merged to `main` after the run was created is absent from what the re-run executes, and the stated remedy (merge `main`, push a new head) is the only one. No other claim changed.

**Check-runs on this head:** every non-skipped check-run is `completed · success`, including the two required contexts `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, the PR-body guards, Test Core, Test UI and all Lint and Type Check lanes. No run is in progress and none is red.

No must-fix. No new should-fix.
